lines.text: After finishing the parables, Jesus goes to His hometown and teaches the people in their synagogue.
The people are astonished and ask where Jesus got such wisdom and miraculous powers.
They call Him the shepherd's son and name His mother Mary and His brothers James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas.
They take offense at Him, and Jesus says a prophet is without honor only in big cities and royal courts.

wrong_details.true: his hometown and in his own household

lines.text: Jesus does not do many miracles there, because of their unbelief.
